subject: Graduate Consultant - Rail (2027 intake), Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I am applying via SEEK for the Graduate Consultant - Rail role (2027 Graduate intake) listed for Melbourne.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as field engineer and project-in-charge.

I am Melton based, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available to start in February 2027 for office, site and project work.

Your Rail team's graduate path, with real project support from week one and mentoring across civil and related disciplines, is the consulting start I am seeking. I do not yet have Australian rail consulting employment, so I am looking for structured graduate mentoring.

I have attached my resume and cover letter. Academic transcripts can be combined as requested. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

macdarenz@gmail.com

paragraphs: I am applying for the Graduate Consultant - Rail role in Melbourne for the 2027 Graduate intake, found on SEEK (job 95007162). The advert asks for a resume, cover letter and academic transcripts as a single document, with a February 2027 start.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language. Coursework covered road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, Australian Standards and Austroads guides, and Before You Dig Australia enquiries. In 2019 I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, reviewed drawings, and carried out inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials and prepared site, material and progress reports.

I have no Australian rail consulting employment yet. I am based in Melton, Victoria, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available to start in February 2027.

Supporting rail and rolling stock projects with mentoring across disciplines matches what I want to learn next. My resume is attached and drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I can supply transcripts in the combined pack SEEK requests.
